newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOV CONSTRUCTIONS FALL 3.6 PERCENT M/M.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOV CONSTRUCTIONS FALL 3.6 PERCENT M/M.

text.p: Hungarian constructions fell a seasonally adjusted 3.6 percent in volume terms month on month in November, the Central Statistical Office (CSO) said on Wednesday.
Compared to November 1995, the industry grew 9.6 percent, the CSO added.

Most of the month-on-month decline stemmed from an 18.6 percent fall in specialised building and fitting industry, which was partly offset by a 12.5 percent increase maintainance and refurbishments and by a 1.4 percent increase in the construction of high-rises.
Underground construction shrunk by 1.5 percent compared to October.
